Q1.(a) What property of the liquid crystals allows or stops the light to pass through them in a
Liquid Crystal Display?
[2]

[3]

Q4.(a) What is the picket fence problem caused due to scan conversion? [2]

object is yellow in color and the background is blue; find the intensity values of each pixel
in the grid after applying anti aliasing.

4/9 1    8/9
1    7/9   0

[2]
(b)
Let there be the rectangular clipping window whose lower left corner is at L (-4, -3) and

[3]

Q6.(a) What is the role of a video controller? [2]
